processes.title: EHSS Performance Monitoring, Measurement and Evaluation
processes.purpose: Maaden uses reliable EHSS performance information to evaluate achievement of intended outcomes, fulfilment of applicable performance criteria and effectiveness of controls, and to identify matters requiring operational response or consideration through Management Review and Continual Improvement.
processes.scope: This process applies to EHSS performance monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation and reporting across Business Units and Corporate Functions, including contractor activities within Maaden’s management control.

clauses.heading: Accountability and Monitoring Framework
clauses.text: Business Units, sites and Corporate functions shall establish responsibilities and competent resources for the collection, verification, analysis, evaluation, authorization, communication and retention of EHSS performance information within their assigned scope.

clauses.heading: Accountability and Monitoring Framework
clauses.text: Monitoring, measurement and evaluation arrangements shall define, as applicable, what is monitored or measured, the purpose and evaluation criteria, methods, frequency or triggers, responsibilities, information ownership, and verification, reporting and escalation requirements.

clauses.heading: Accountability and Monitoring Framework
clauses.text: The nature, timing and frequency of monitoring, measurement and evaluation shall be proportionate to applicable obligations, EHSS risks, controls, operational variability, performance history, information reliability and changes.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Maaden shall establish common Corporate EHSS performance indicators required for governance, aggregation and Corporate EHSS performance reporting.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Business Units and Corporate Functions shall establish additional EHSS performance indicators where required by their risks, obligations, objectives, activities or operating conditions.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Performance indicators shall be relevant to defined EHSS outcomes, risks, controls, objectives or obligations; measurable or capable of objective evaluation; supported by reliable and verifiable information; and suitable for evaluating performance and trends.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: The EHSS performance indicator framework shall include leading and lagging indicators and measures of control implementation and effectiveness.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Corporate EHSS performance indicators shall be managed in accordance with the approved Maaden EHSS KPI Bluebook, including applicable definitions, calculation or assessment methods, evidence requirements, evaluation criteria and scoring methods.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Common definitions, reporting boundaries and calculation methods shall be used where EHSS performance information is aggregated or compared across Maaden.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Differences in indicator definitions, scope, calculation methods, risk exposure, operating context or information quality that could affect interpretation or comparability shall be identified when information is aggregated, compared, benchmarked or communicated.

clauses.heading: Performance Indicators and Information Sources
clauses.text: Performance evaluation shall integrate relevant information from operational monitoring, critical control verification, incidents and investigations, occupational health, environmental monitoring, process safety, security, audits and assessments, contractor oversight and other applicable EHSS processes.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: EHSS performance information shall be collected and maintained in accordance with applicable indicator definitions, Corporate EHSS reporting requirements and the approved Maaden EHSS KPI Bluebook where applicable. The information shall be complete, accurate, traceable, consistent and available for the applicable reporting period.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: Where Maaden designates a Corporate system for EHSS performance information, that system shall be used as the authoritative source. Information obtained from other sources shall be supported by traceable evidence.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: EHSS performance information shall be verified before use or submission. The extent of verification shall reflect its reporting purpose and potential effect on compliance, performance scoring or decision making. Verification shall confirm, as applicable, the source evidence, reporting scope and period, calculation or assessment method, and evaluation or scoring criteria.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: Monitoring and measuring equipment whose accuracy can affect the validity of an EHSS result shall be maintained and verified or calibrated in accordance with defined requirements, with traceability to recognized measurement standards where available and applicable.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: Invalid, incomplete, estimated or uncertain performance information shall be corrected where practicable or clearly identified in the applicable evaluation and communication, including the nature and effect of the limitation.

clauses.heading: Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance
clauses.text: EHSS performance information, including personal, medical, security sensitive or other restricted information, shall be protected in accordance with applicable legal and Maaden information protection requirements.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Business Units and Corporate functions shall analyze EHSS performance information within their assigned scope to identify performance trends and deviations, recurring or systemic control weaknesses, emerging risks and matters requiring response or escalation.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: EHSS performance shall be evaluated against applicable legal, regulatory and permit criteria; MSHEM requirements, objectives and plans; and defined risk, control and process performance criteria.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Performance evaluation shall determine whether intended outcomes and applicable criteria are being achieved, required controls are implemented and effective, performance is improving, stable or deteriorating, and further monitoring, investigation, escalation or action is required.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Business Units and Corporate functions shall identify performance indicators or evaluation methods requiring revision where they no longer provide reliable or meaningful information for evaluating the intended outcome.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Evaluation of significant incidents and control failures shall consider both actual outcomes and, where relevant, credible potential consequences.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Matters requiring immediate operational control, investigation, notification or regulatory response shall be escalated through the applicable MSHEM process without waiting for periodic performance reporting or Management Review.

clauses.heading: Analysis and Evaluation
clauses.text: Significant performance conclusions, adverse trends, systemic weaknesses and matters requiring management decision shall be provided as inputs to Section 6.4 Management Review and Continual Improvement.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: EHSS performance information required for Corporate reporting shall be verified and reviewed and approved by the Business Unit or Corporate Function EHSS VP before final submission.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Corporate EHSS shall consolidate and validate submitted EHSS performance information against approved Maaden reporting requirements and the EHSS KPI Bluebook. Applicable technical functions shall support validation where technical interpretation or scoring is required. Performance information shall not be treated as final until issues are resolved and the required supporting evidence is available.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Reporting errors shall be corrected through a controlled and traceable process that documents the reason for correction, supporting evidence, applicable authorization and the corrected result or score.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Maaden shall prepare periodic and annual consolidated EHSS performance information for applicable governance, communication and consideration under Section 6.4 Management Review and Continual Improvement.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Performance information that is preliminary, estimated, incomplete, corrected or subject to significant limitations or conditions shall be clearly identified where its status could affect interpretation or decision making.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Corporate EHSS performance indicators, applicable Bluebook criteria and related evaluation arrangements shall be reviewed at intervals defined through approved EHSS KPI Bluebook governance and following change to confirm that they remain relevant to their intended outcomes; use reliable information sources and valid criteria; support consistent aggregation, evaluation and decision making; and do not create unintended consequences affecting reporting behavior or information reliability.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Changes to Corporate performance indicator definitions, calculation or assessment methods, evidence requirements, reporting boundaries or scoring criteria shall be controlled through approved EHSS KPI Bluebook governance arrangements.

clauses.heading: Validation, Reporting and Records
clauses.text: Documented information supporting EHSS performance monitoring, verification, evaluation, authorization, reporting and correction shall be controlled, retained, retrievable and protected in accordance with applicable Maaden, legal and regulatory requirements.

processes.keywords: EHSS Performance Monitoring, Measurement and Evaluation; KPI, monitoring, performance, measurement, reporting; Accountability and Monitoring Framework; Performance Indicators and Information Sources; Data Integrity and Measurement Assurance; Analysis and Evaluation; Validation, Reporting and Records
processes.trigger: if performance, compliance, exposure, control or monitoring data must be measured or evaluated

processes.title: EHSS Audit and Assurance
processes.purpose: Maaden obtains risk-based, objective and sufficiently independent assurance that applicable EHSS requirements and critical controls are implemented and effective, and that identified deficiencies are corrected, escalated and used to support continual improvement.
processes.scope: This process applies to all Maaden Business Units and Corporate Functions within the scope of MSHEM.

clauses.heading: Assurance Framework and Governance
clauses.text:
Maaden shall establish and maintain three coordinated layers of EHSS audit and assurance:
a. Self-Assessment, conducted by the applicable Business Unit or site to verify conformity with MSHEM requirements and the implementation and effectiveness of applicable controls;
b. Internal Audit, conducted or commissioned by the applicable Business Unit with independence from the activities and processes being audited; and
c. Corporate Audit, conducted or commissioned through Corporate EHSS to provide independent corporate-level assurance of conformity with MSHEM requirements and the implementation and effectiveness of applicable controls.

clauses.heading: Assurance Framework and Governance
clauses.text: Regulatory, certification, independent third-party, special and unscheduled assurance shall be integrated into the Audit and Assurance Program where required by an applicable obligation or defined assurance need.

clauses.heading: Assurance Framework and Governance
clauses.text: Maaden shall define accountability, authority, independence and resource requirements for the Audit and Assurance Program. Audit and assurance activities shall be conducted objectively, impartially and with due professional care using risk-based methods and verifiable evidence. Audit arrangements shall identify and control conflicts of interest and protect audit evidence, findings, conclusions and reporting from interference.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Business Units and Corporate Functions shall establish, approve, implement and maintain a risk-based five-year EHSS Audit and Assurance Program supported by annual plans that define assurance coverage, timing, priorities, responsibilities, independence and resource requirements considering applicable MSHEM processes, material risks, critical controls, obligations, incidents, findings, performance trends and significant change.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Changes, cancellations or deferrals affecting planned assurance coverage shall be risk assessed, authorized and recorded.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text:
Each applicable Business Unit shall complete the following minimum assurance sequence over each recurring three- year cycle:
a. a Self-Assessment in the first year;
b. an Internal Audit in the second year; and
c. a Corporate Audit or qualifying independent third-party assessment in the third year.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: The five-year EHSS Audit and Assurance Program shall identify the applicable year of the three-year assurance cycle for each Business Unit and shall maintain continuity of the cycle across successive program periods.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: The three-year assurance sequence establishes the minimum assurance frequency and level and shall not prevent additional or more frequent assurance where required by risk, performance, change or an applicable obligation.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Self-Assessments shall verify the documented arrangements established to implement MSHEM and the implementation and effectiveness of applicable requirements and controls.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Internal Audits shall evaluate conformity with applicable MSHEM, legal, regulatory and permit requirements and shall be conducted by competent personnel independent of the activities being audited.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: A Corporate Audit or qualifying independent third-party assessment may satisfy a required assurance activity where equivalent or greater assurance is achieved, no applicable obligation is displaced, and the substitution is approved and recorded in the Audit and Assurance Program.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Unscheduled or additional assurance shall be completed where required by significant risk, incidents, noncompliance, control failures, adverse performance or material change.

clauses.heading: Audit and Assurance Program
clauses.text: Regulatory, certification, permit and other obligation-driven assurance shall be completed at the frequency required by the applicable obligation and shall not be displaced by the three-year assurance cycle.

clauses.heading: Audit Planning and Execution
clauses.text: Each audit shall have defined objectives, scope, criteria and methods appropriate to the audit purpose, risks and applicable Audit and Assurance Program.

clauses.heading: Audit Planning and Execution
clauses.text: Personnel managing, leading, conducting or supporting audits shall be competent for their assigned responsibilities, with audit teams collectively possessing the audit, EHSS, legal, operational and technical competence required for the audit scope and objectives.

clauses.heading: Audit Planning and Execution
clauses.text: The accountable auditee shall provide authorized access to personnel, locations, activities, systems, documented information and other evidence necessary to achieve the audit objectives.

clauses.heading: Audit Planning and Execution
clauses.text: Audit findings and conclusions shall be based on relevant and verifiable evidence evaluated against the approved audit criteria. Where sampling is used, limitations affecting confidence in the audit conclusions shall be recognized.

clauses.heading: Audit Planning and Execution
clauses.text: Material EHSS risks, legal or regulatory non-compliance and significant critical control failures identified during an audit shall be promptly escalated and controlled without waiting for completion of the final audit report.

clauses.heading: Findings, Reporting and Corrective Action
clauses.text:
Audit results shall be supported by objective evidence and referenced to the applicable audit criterion. Audit results shall distinguish non-conformities and non-compliances from observations, improvement opportunities and recognized good practices and shall be evaluated using the Compliance-Based and Risk-Based classification criteria, as applicable.
a. Compliance-Based Classification:
• Fully Implemented: the applicable requirement is implemented and effective.
• Acceptable / Implemented with Areas for Improvement: the requirement is substantially implemented and effective, with areas for improvement identified.
• Minor Improvements Required / Partially Implemented with Minor Gaps: the requirement is generally implemented, but minor gaps or weaknesses exist.
• Major Improvements Required / Not Well Implemented with Major Gaps: material gaps or weaknesses exist in implementation or effectiveness.
• Unacceptable Nonconformance / Not Implemented: the requirement is not implemented, or implementation is materially inadequate or ineffective.
b. Risk-Based Classification: Where a non-conformity, non-compliance or other material deficiency is identified, its significance shall be classified as: Critical, High, Significant, Medium and Low. Risk-based classification shall consider, as applicable, actual or potential EHSS consequence, systemic significance, legal or regulatory significance, critical-control impact and recurrence.

clauses.heading: Findings, Reporting and Corrective Action
clauses.text: Findings shall be reviewed with the auditee for factual accuracy without compromising auditor independence. An authorized audit report shall document or reference the audit objectives, scope, criteria, findings and classifications, conclusions, significant limitations, and required corrective or follow-up actions.

clauses.heading: Findings, Reporting and Corrective Action
clauses.text: Findings meeting the defined escalation criteria, including significant, systemic, recurring, critical control or legal and regulatory findings, shall be promptly escalated.

clauses.heading: Findings, Reporting and Corrective Action
clauses.text: The accountable auditee shall implement correction where required, identify causes proportionate to the significance of the finding, assign corrective actions with accountable owners and completion dates, provide evidence of implementation, and ensure overdue, deferred or changed actions are appropriately escalated and authorized.

clauses.heading: Findings, Reporting and Corrective Action
clauses.text: Findings shall be closed only after corrective actions have been implemented and verified. Corrective action effectiveness and follow-up assurance shall be proportionate to the significance and recurrence of the finding, and ineffective actions shall remain open or be reopened .

clauses.heading: External Assurance, Program Monitoring and Records
clauses.text: Findings and commitments arising from regulatory inspections, certification audits and external assurance shall be assigned, tracked, implemented and closed within the applicable response period.

clauses.heading: External Assurance, Program Monitoring and Records
clauses.text: Implementation of the Audit and Assurance Program shall be monitored to confirm completion of planned assurance activities, coverage of applicable MSHEM processes and obligations, significant findings and trends, and corrective action completion and effectiveness.

clauses.heading: External Assurance, Program Monitoring and Records
clauses.text: A missed minimum assurance frequency shall be escalated and shall not be considered fulfilled solely by revising or rescheduling the program.

clauses.heading: External Assurance, Program Monitoring and Records
clauses.text: Material assurance results, systemic or recurring findings, significant trends and unresolved corrective action risks shall be provided as inputs to Section 6.4 Management Review and Continual Improvement.

clauses.heading: External Assurance, Program Monitoring and Records
clauses.text: Audit and assurance records shall be controlled, protected and retained in accordance with applicable Maaden, legal, regulatory, permit and contractual requirements.

processes.title: Management Review and Continual Improvement
processes.purpose: Maaden management reviews the continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of MSHEM and implements prioritized improvements to EHSS performance and the management system.
processes.scope: This process applies to all Business Units and Corporate Functions for the management review and continual improvement of MSHEM implementation, effectiveness and EHSS performance within their areas of responsibility.

clauses.heading: Management Review Arrangements
clauses.text: All Business Units and Corporate Functions shall conduct management reviews at planned intervals through the forums specified in Table 6.4-1 to evaluate EHSS performance and the continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of MSHEM.

clauses.heading: Management Review Arrangements
clauses.text: Each management review forum shall be chaired by the accountable management role specified in Table 6.4-1.

clauses.heading: Management Review Arrangements
clauses.text: Each management review shall include personnel with the authority and knowledge required to evaluate performance, make decisions and escalate matters where necessary.

clauses.heading: Management Review Arrangements
clauses.text:
Business Units and Corporate Functions shall evaluate whether an EHSS issue requires management action before the next scheduled review and determine the appropriate management review, escalation or decision making arrangement.
[Table table-219-1.png]

Table 6.4-1. Required EHSS Review and Engagement Forums.

clauses.heading: Management Review Inputs
clauses.text: Corporate, Business Units and site management reviews shall consider, as applicable the status and effectiveness of actions from previous reviews; changes in activities, organizational context and interested-party expectations; changes in legal, regulatory, permit and other requirements; achievement of EHSS policy commitments, objectives, targets and plans; EHSS performance and significant trends; incidents, high-potential events and relevant learning; EHSS risks and critical control performance; compliance evaluation, audit and assurance results; contractor EHSS performance; workforce concerns, participation and relevant communications; the adequacy of resources; and opportunities for continual improvement.

clauses.heading: Management Review Inputs
clauses.text: Lower level meetings shall provide relevant information, concerns and unresolved matters to the next applicable level of management review.

clauses.heading: Management Review Inputs
clauses.text: Information used for management review shall be sufficiently complete and reliable to support the decisions being made.

clauses.heading: Management Review Evaluation and Outputs
clauses.text:
Corporate Functions, Business Units and Sites management reviews shall evaluate:
a. whether MSHEM remains suitable for the activities, risks, obligations and operating context under review;
b. whether MSHEM requirements, governance, resources and controls are sufficient; and
c. whether MSHEM is effectively implemented and achieving the intended EHSS outcomes.

clauses.heading: Management Review Evaluation and Outputs
clauses.text: Management review outputs shall include decisions on required corrective and improvement actions; improvement priorities; changes to MSHEM or its implementation; resources required; changes to EHSS objectives, targets or plans; opportunities to improve integration with business processes; and matters requiring escalation.

clauses.heading: Management Review Evaluation and Outputs
clauses.text: Matters exceeding the authority of the reviewing forum shall be escalated to the management level authorized to decide them.

clauses.heading: Management Review Evaluation and Outputs
clauses.text: Relevant decisions and directions shall be communicated to affected functions, workers and contractors.

clauses.heading: Continual Improvement
clauses.text: Business Units, Corporate Functions and Sites shall identify and implement opportunities to improve EHSS performance and the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of MSHEM.

clauses.heading: Continual Improvement
clauses.text: Improvement priorities shall consider applicable obligations; EHSS risks and credible high consequence events; critical control weaknesses; incidents and recurring findings; negative performance trends; and opportunities with potential Maaden wide benefit.

clauses.heading: Continual Improvement
clauses.text: Relevant learning and effective practices shall be shared across affected Business Units, Sites and Corporate Functions.

clauses.heading: Continual Improvement
clauses.text: Changes arising from management review or continual improvement shall be implemented through the applicable MSHEM process, including Management of Change where required .

clauses.heading: Actions and Effectiveness
clauses.text: Decisions requiring action shall define the accountable owner, required outcome and target completion date.

clauses.heading: Actions and Effectiveness
clauses.text: Actions shall be tracked to completion and escalated where overdue or where the related risk or performance gap has materially changed.

clauses.heading: Actions and Effectiveness
clauses.text: Action closure shall include verification of effectiveness where necessary to confirm that the required outcome was achieved.

clauses.heading: Actions and Effectiveness
clauses.text: An action found to be ineffective shall be revised, replaced or escalated and recurring or systemic action failures shall be evaluated for applicability across other Business Units, Sites or MSHEM processes.

clauses.heading: Actions and Effectiveness
clauses.text: Management review and supporting meeting records shall provide traceability between the matters reviewed, decisions, assigned actions and action outcomes.
